items.summary: Recommendation: approve three reversible control-plane product specifications, with no site edits or production queue entries during containment. Prioritize approval-to-execution reconciliation, failure-aware repair-or-close states, and measurement-readiness gates. Continue existing repair, reconciliation, and legal/security evidence work; preserve all site opportunities as deferred backlog.
